purpose: Deterministic text-to-structure fidelity benchmark with explicit part multiplicities and a complete directed attachment tree.

design.evaluation_unit_note: Prompt-level metrics are reported, but confidence intervals and paraphrase consistency use base_structure_id as the cluster/unit where appropriate.
design.important_scope: This benchmark measures fidelity to explicitly stated structural facts. It does not measure open-ended plausibility or 3D geometry quality.
